subject: Extended Operating Hours for Private Clubs
overview: The commission reviewed whether private clubs require a City Council special permit to operate past 11:00 p.m. following a discrepancy on renewal licenses. The commission voted to allow existing clubs to continue operating until 1:00 a.m. while seeking a formal legal opinion from KP Law.

items.title: Club Operating Hours and Special Permit Requirements
items.summary: Approved a motion permitting existing clubs to continue operating until 1:00 a.m. without a City Council special permit while the commission seeks a legal opinion from KP Law on whether municipal zoning bylaws apply to private clubs.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Fundraiser Inquiries
items.summary: Staff confirmed that previously passed commission rules take effect upon approval of meeting minutes and clarified that alcohol licensing for community fundraisers requires prior authorization from the host venue.
